description: Defines topological common-tree embeddings through injective vertex images and separated paths, develops a valid/invalid fork example, distinguishes selected versus skipped vertices, and reads the exact source-to-skeleton correspondence in Lean.

related_resources.reason: Pinned 2018 arXiv v1 / MFCS 2018, Definitions 1–2 and independent common-embedding semantics.

learning_objectives: Explain ancestry and branch-intersection clauses of Definition 1
Construct common-tree pair maps and disallow hidden branch points using a concrete counterexample
Distinguish rooted, root-to-root and unrooted witness requirements
Read both directions of the independent skeleton/source-embedding equivalence in Lean
